results.title: Foley — Out of your head. Into your day. A voice to-do list
results.content:
01Capture

### Tap the mark. Say it. Let go.

The capture sheet listens while you talk. Say one thing or several; Foley works out the tasks, the dates and the project before anything lands.

> “Water the plants on Thursday evening”

02Filed, and said

### Filed, not just heard.

What it saved is on the sheet, with the project and the time already set. Then it says so out loud - one sentence, by the same rules on every device - and the words stay on the screen whether or not the voice plays.

03Your day

### Overdue, today, tomorrow.

The Timeline groups what is late, what is due today and what the week holds, across every project, so the day is one glance.

04Plan

### Ask what to work on first. [...] 04Plan

### Ask what to work on first.

Foley answers from what is actually on your list, in the Plan tab. When it needs to know where before it goes looking, it asks instead of guessing. Signed in, the phone, the desk and the browser share one list.

> “What should I work on first?”

The phone app, re-created on the page from the app's own design vectors. Example tasks; no microphone, AI service or account is connected.

Foley on Apple Watch (watchOS 10 or later) and on Wear OS watches (Wear OS 3 or later) is the capture mark, the questions it needs to ask, and your day. Say it, answer, and it is filed with the rest.

Great ideas vanish before you can type them. By the time you open an app, you've forgotten half of what you wanted to capture.

### Typing Kills Flow

Stopping to type breaks your momentum. Whether you're cooking, driving, or in a meeting, typing interrupts what you're doing.

### Disorganized Lists [...] ### Disorganized Lists

## From voice to tasks in seconds

Three simple steps to transform how you capture and organize your thoughts.

### Record

Tap the microphone and speak naturally. Say everything that's on your mind — meetings, errands, ideas.

OpenAI Whisper transcribes your voice with near-perfect accuracy. Gemini AI extracts and structures your tasks.
